I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands is November 3, 2025.

That date comes from Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02 and Bettina's Dec 8, 2025 cutover recap, which both give it. The recap also says Kwame fully took over day to day on November 22, 2025, so I suggested that date for any CRM field about when he started working the account.

I didn't open the CRM record itself, so I told him the answer rests on those two notes. Both files are public.
